# OSTAZE (أستاذي)

> Online tutoring marketplace connecting university students in Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the Gulf with verified university tutors for live Zoom lessons and recorded courses. Bilingual Arabic/English.

OSTAZE lets students browse universities, colleges and subjects, find a verified tutor, and book a live one-to-one session or enrol in a recorded course. Tutors can apply to join the platform.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search tutors, subjects and universities.
- [Tutors](/teachers): Browse verified university tutors and book sessions.
- [Subjects](/subjects): All subjects available for tutoring.
- [Universities](/universities): Universities and colleges by country, with course catalogs.
- [Categories](/categories): Academic categories and fields of study.
- [Courses](/courses): Recorded courses students can enrol in.
- [Apply as a Tutor](/apply-tutor): Application form for teachers who want to join.
- [About](/about): About OSTAZE.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the team.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about booking, payments and lessons.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
